programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Josh unngår så vidt katastrofe når han kjører inn i gruven med et last drivstoff, og Claudia er knust når en jadeplate sprekker i to mens hun kjører den under sagen.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudia og Robin prøver desperat å finne en ny jadestein før kjøperen trekker seg, men de går snart tom for tid og alternativer.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudia henvender seg til sin far Steve for hjelp da hun frykter at det største salget i hennes gruvekarriere er i ferd med å glippe.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Spenningsnivået øker mellom Claudia, Robin og Josh når de gjør et siste forsøk på å inngå en avtale med en kjøper fra Vietnam.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Flytting av en massiv jadeplate setter både gruvens gamle utstyr og Josh' tålmodighet på prøve.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Transporten av en 20 tonns stein på den farlige veien ut av gruven viser seg å være for mye for den gamle lastebilen 6-Pack.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Robin oppdager en stor jadelinse på Two Mile, men det kan vise seg vanskelig for den lille operasjonen deres å grave den ut.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Når en høyst uvanlig august snøstorm fanger Claudia og Robin på Two Mile prøver Gary og Garon å redde dagen ved å kjøre gjennom stormen for å bringe forsyninger.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Robin tar en tøff beslutning om sin kjære gruvebil 6 Pack etter nok et kostbart sammenbrudd.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Vinteren nærmer seg og Claudia presser sitt utslitte mannskap til bristepunktet, noe som får temperamentet til å blusse opp og tvinger Claudia til endelig å ta en for laget.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Den nye gruvesesongen er full av ubehagelige overraskelser, men en usannsynlig redning redder dagen.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Josh er lei av å jobbe for sin egen far og starter sin egen transportvirksomhet med en ny Semi.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Den militære lastebilen faller om på den brutale veien til gruven.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Gary og sønnen redder en gammel militærlastebil, men å kjøre den opp til gruven viser seg å være vanskelig.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Garon og Josh mister kontrollen over Six Pack på de gjørmete veiene.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Justin flyr inn med en ny wiresag, men mister besinnelsen når han prøver å sette den opp.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Mannskapet støter på uendelige problemer når de forsøker kutte ut en del av den 60 fot lange linsen.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudia bringer med massivt boreutstyr og har bare fire dager på å finne den beste jaden, men hun og Robin er uenige om hvor de skal lete.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Teamet tar i et ekstra tak når en sen sesonginnspurt tvinger de til å grave i to gruver samtidig.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Mannskapet trekker jadesteiner opp av J-linsen, men en stort problem på veien setter alt i fare.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Når Claudia og Robin ikke finner jade under prøveboringen klarer selv ikke firmaets geologer enes om en plan.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudia, Robin og mannskapet sliter med å frakte tungt utstyr opp et fjell før stigende vannivå i elver gjør det umulig å nå gruveområdet.

programme.desc: Mannskapet prøver å frakte maskinene over stigende elver for å grave ut den nye fjellgruven.

programme.desc: Robin forsøker å trosse fysiske lover ved å sette opp en massiv sovebrakke i deres selverklærte Wolverine-område.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Flere uhell rammer Jade-mannskapet, og alle kommer opp med sine egne løsninger for å jage vekk demonene.

programme.title: Matlock: The Mayor (Part 1)
programme.desc: Matlock uncovers unflattering secrets about the late mayor of Chicago while defending an aging hippie activist accused of the man’s assassination.

programme.title: Matlock: The Mayor (Part 2)
programme.desc: Matlock’s trip to the Windy City to defend a 1960’s radical accused of murdering Chicago’s mayor comes to a head in the second part of this dramatic two-part episode.

programme.title: Matlock: The Black Widow
programme.desc: Matlock takes the case of Ken Wilson, convicted of murdering his wife, whose body was never found. Recently released from prison after seven years, Wilson sets out to find his missing wife but gets arrested again.

programme.title: Matlock: The Other Woman
programme.desc: A disappearing diary, a missing mistress and a preposterous police report pose problems for Matlock when he agrees to defend a psychiatrist, Lucas Forbes.

programme.title: Matlock: The Psychic
programme.desc: Matlock defends a prominent psychic, Jennifer Holtz, who foresees her boyfriend’s murder and is subsequently arrested when he is found dead and Jennifer has no alibi.

programme.title: Matlock: The Thief (Part 1)
programme.desc: A rare-coin dealer invests his trust in Matlock when he’s accused of murdering an employee who was caught stealing valuable coins. Meanwhile, Tyler becomes disgruntled when Matlock hires another private investigator, Linda Hansfield, to work on the case.

programme.title: Matlock: The Thief (Part 2)
programme.desc: While defending a coin dealer accused of murdering an employee, Matlock and Tyler suspect the new investigator Ben hired, Linda Hansfield, is being blackmailed by the real kIller.

programme.title: Matlock: The Thoroughbred
programme.desc: A picturesque thoroughbred horse farm provides an unusual setting for murder when Ben Matlock defends a slow-witted stable hand, Tommy Jenks, accused of killing the stable owner’s daughter.

programme.title: Matlock: The Model
programme.desc: Ben Matlock defends a renowned journalist accused of murdering a beautiful international model. Matlock’s investigation is stalled when he is struck by a car and lands in the hospital with a slight case of amnesia.

programme.title: Matlock: The Cult
programme.desc: Matlock believes in the innocence of a man whose brainwashed son insists he saw his father kill the leader of his cult. Ben is the only hope left for a concerned father whose son, David, has been swept into a religious cult.

programme.title: Matlock: The Priest
programme.desc: A lawyer friend of Matlock’s puts his faith in the crafty attorney when his client is accused of killing a feisty priest, Father Fitzgerald.

programme.title: Matlock: The Witness
programme.desc: Ben Matlock gives his assistant, Michelle Thomas, her toughest courtroom assignment... breaking down the eyewitness testimony of a former law classmate in a brutal murder case.

programme.title: Matlock: The Best Seller
programme.desc: District Attorney Julie March matches wits with tempestuous author Cynthia Slayton, whose torrid novels are suddenly eclipsed by facts surrounding the death of her best friend.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Lightning War
programme.desc: Country after European country falls before the unstoppable German blitzkrieg.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Colt M1911, designed by John Moses Browning, is the 20th century's most influential pistol. Its .45 ACP cartridge made it the U.S. military's standard for 75 years. Wil Willis tests it to explore its stopping power.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Killer Police
programme.desc: In Ukraine and Lithuania, Nazi invaders were welcomed as liberators. In Lithuania, Antanas Gecas led a militia that executed hundreds of Jews. Ukrainian nationalists participated in pogroms slaughtering 34,000 Jews in two days.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: France and Spain: The Pyrenees
programme.desc: Monty treks one of the toughest and most famous freedom trails out of Nazi controlled France, taking him through the valleys and high ridges of the Pyrenees mountains and into Spain.

programme.title: Secret War: The Mafia Connection
programme.desc: Lucky Luciano, a mafia boss of the 1930s, was in jail in 1942 on charges of running prostitution rings. US intelligence services did a deal with him and he got the Italians to share intelligence on German U boat movements.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Today’s infantry demands a weapon combining machine gun firepower with rifle accuracy and mobility.. Host Wil Willis traces this journey through iconic firearms.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Special Forces operate deep behind enemy lines with top-of-the-line weapons.Host Wil Willis tests the Sig Sauer P226, the preferred choice like the Mark 25 by Navy SEALs, against competitors like the H&K Compact Tactical.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Gatling Gun, designed to change 19th-century battlefields, now reigns supreme in the skies as a high-speed offensive weapon. With a 150-year legacy of havoc it continues to be a formidable force.

programme.title: Secret War: Double Agent Tricycle
programme.desc: Dusan Popov was almost certainly James Bond. Ian Fleming knew all the stories about him. Popov managed to persuade both the Germans and MI6 to keep him in the style of a millionaire businessman while performing a series of missions against the Nazis.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Slovenia: The Crow's Flight
programme.desc: Monty heads to Slovenia to retrace one of the most daring, yet unknown, mass escapes of Allied prisoners during the second world war, made possible only with the help of partisans and locals.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The AK-47, the world's deadliest firearm, sparked a Cold War race for superior assault rifles like the American M4 and German HK 416. Host Wil Willis explores its history, from Mikhail Kalashnikov's WWII experiences to its assembly and lethal impact.

programme.title: Secret War: The Dutch Disaster
programme.desc: Operation North Pole was a WWII German deception using captured SOE agents to mislead Britain. 47 of 50 agents were captured. Despite warnings, SOE ignored signs of compromise to maintain support, leading to a major intelligence failure.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Host Wil Willis tests the Garand against the Arisaka Type 99, showcasing its impact in WWII and sniper rifles' deadly precision, from Carlos Hathcock to Craig Harrison. Witness the historic rifles that shaped warfare!

programme.title: The Real Oppenheimer
programme.desc: I 1945 ble verden ført inn i atomalderen. Rollen hans som "Father of the Bomb" var satt , og Oppenheimer ble stadig mer bekymret for den potensielle faren denne vitenskapelige oppfinnelser kunne utgjøre for menneskeheten.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: End Game
programme.desc: In January 1945, Nazi Germany faces defeat as Allied armies close in. Hitler, aged 55 and in poor health, remains defiant in his Berlin bunker. On April 30th, 1945, Hitler commits suicide, and days later, Germany surrenders, ending World War II.

programme.title: Secret War: The Banker, the Norwegians & the Bomb
programme.desc: Sir Charles attended Eton, and then joined the Coldstream Guards. He won the Military Cross on the Western Front and, having survived the war, returned to banking.
programme.sub-title: The Banker, the Norwegians & the Bomb

programme.title: Secret War: Christine Granville
programme.desc: Christine Granville, aka Krystyna Skarbek, a brave SOE agent, secured the release of captured comrades from the Gestapo before Operation Dragoon, earning the George Medal.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Traitor-in-Chief
programme.desc: Pierre Laval, once celebrated and later reviled, faced execution in 1945 for collaboration with the Nazis during Vichy France. Originally a socialist and pacifist, he fell into collaboration for power and to navigate the horrors of occupation.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: The Iron Chef is called upon to face Miyoko Sakai, a famed Thai food critic who has had the privilege to learn the secrets of royal Thai cuisine straight from the source.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Iron Chef Morimoto faces another traditionalist who is infamous for his temper, his steadfast discipline and his adherence to tradition.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: The challenger in this battle of peach is Masanobu Watabe, owner of Le Rameau d'Or in Yokohama, Japan. Watabe runs the entire 22-seat restaurant by himself.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Chen's challenger is a man who masters Chaozhou-style Chinese cuisine, an exacting style that is actually able to please the sensitive tastes of customers in Kyoto.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Sakai battles the 'conjurer of garlic,' a chef who embraces the pungent ingredient as real Italians do. Sakai is further challenged to use live squids in the dishes.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Three years after losing to Iron Chef Chen, the Italian restaurant Sabatini demands a rematch, this time sending in the master chef of their Tokyo restaurant.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Led by Tadamichi Ohta, the chef who defeated Sakai, the Ohta faction invades Kitchen Stadium to uphold traditional Japanese cuisine. Fuji is team Ohta's first contender against Morimoto.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: In honor of the Girls' Festival, Kaga invites a challenger from the ancient city of Kamakura, Motohito Kondo, who was trained in Kyoto and is an expert in both tea and sake.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Tasaki is a world champion sommelier who has always dreamed of becoming a famed chef. Chairman Kaga decides to grant him his wish.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: The American chef Ron Seigel challenges Iron Chef Sakai in this battle of lobster. Who will emerge victorious?

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: The first female challenger at Kitchen Stadium, the 26-year-old Kagata defeated Chef Chen. Years later, she returns to fight Chen again with milk-fed veal.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Natto, a Japanese delicacy, is the ingredient of battle for Iron Chef Morimoto and Tatsutoshi Kumamoto.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Iron Chef Kobe is pitted against an unusual chef of Italian cuisine who operates out of his own food cart.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Nagayama was brought in to revive the venerated Tokyo University restaurant Shochiku and now he will fight against an Iron Chef.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: When it comes to Bok Choy, you know that Iron Chef Chen will be there to defend his honor against Hisao Yaginuma.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: The challenger likes to follow one of the philosophies of Rosanjin: 'never kill the natural flavor of the ingredient.' He is known as the prince of Japanese cuisine.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Chef Marco Molinari surprises everyone in this battle of porcini mushroom with Iron Chef Morimoto.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Iron Chef Sakai's opponent in this battle is from the third generation of a family famous for exploring the world in search of prime ingredients to incorporate into unique recipes.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: No holds are barred in this seafood wrestling match. Who can get their arms around octopus better, Iron Chef Kobe or Challenger Hiromichi Yoneda?

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: If Mitsuo Suganuma chooses to battle Iron Chef Chen, Chairman Kaga has no choice but to pick shark fin as the theme ingredient.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Larry wants to drive his1959 Cadillac DeVille, but the car has spent decades baking in the Arizona sun. Brian spent years gathering parts to restore his grandfather’s 1960 Bel Air only to find that he’s missing more critical components than he’s found…

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: At FantomWorks, there are 85 cars being worked on and multiple owners who expect miracles. From a vintage motorcycle to getting a 1970 GTO ready for a returning vet, Dan burns the midnight oil to get cars out the door so new arrivals can take their place.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Jerry shows up with a car in pieces, a U-Haul full of parts and a dream of a perfect Plymouth Business Coupe that desperately needs Dan’s help. Bill asks Dan to find him a 1972 Gran Sport and to restore it with hard-to-find features.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: The 63 Z06 is getting more fiber glass work done on the inside. Vinnie is working on replacing the windows on the 442 and putting the guts in the door. Plus, we head to Galveston for the Galveston Corvette Show.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and Jan are visiting Mecum Auctions in Houston, Texas checking out some of the coolest classic muscle cars about to hit the auction block!

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Michael wants a new convertible top for his 1953 Morgan, but the Fantomworks team has no reference, no template and no anchor points. Butch entrusted his 1969 Camaro to a restoration rip-off artist. Can Fantomworks fix the worst work they’ve ever seen?

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team are getting the sound system ready inside the 1969 Mustang Malicious Intent. The 1950 Ford has miles of wiring to install.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: FantomWorks epic 4 year long wrestling match with the 1961 International Harvester Metro concludes with an incredible, one-of-a-kind van. Ray wants his 1969 ZL1 to match the number 68 rally car, but he needs Dan’s rare Winters stamped 427 COPO motor.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team are looking at a custom LS3 motor . The 1960 Corvette is getting work done on its brake pads.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie is in Scottsdale Arizona for Barrett Jackson 2024. There is so much happening, from checking out awesome vendors, looking at awesome classic cars, and even trying amazing food.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie heads to West Texas to pick up a cool car to be serviced. Street Dreams has a shop full of unique classic muscle cars that you have to check out!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Dude, Where's Allysa's Car?
programme.desc: A new season of Graveyard Carz, the show wherein abandoned and left­for­death classic Mopars are given a new lease on life.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Chris asks FantomWorks to breathe new life into a 1951 Mercury Woody that was sitting in a chicken coop for thirty years. Dan’s 1970 Mustang Boss arrives with a long list of problems and the speed of a sea slug.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Will Gets Grumpy
programme.desc: A new season of Graveyard Carz, the show wherein abandoned and left­for­death classic Mopars are given a new lease on life.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Mike wants Dan to make his prized Mach 1 even more of a muscle car. Richard brings FantomWorks the first ‘his and hers’ restoration – a Sunbeam Tiger and a Fiat Spider – but as Dan soon discovers; the challenges of the two cars are not equal.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas are working in the paint booth on the Malicious Intent. The 1966 Mustang is sanding out the car to get it ready for the paint booth. The 86 Camaro is being converted into a sniper system under the hood.

programme.title: The Ride Life
programme.desc: Despite a troubled past of poverty and invasions, Korea has emerged as a car building power-house. Through its unheralded and talented-loaded car scene, Sung reconnects with the land of his birth and finds peace with his estranged mother.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Cuda 'Tat
programme.desc: The world is littered with the remains of forgotten muscle cars. At Graveyard Carz, some will get a second chance in the hands of Mark Worman and the Ghouls.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Emmett believes his 1964 Barracuda is all original. But Dan finds out that the car has hidden damage and a past that nobody expected. Velvet wants Dan to get her 1953 Studebaker Commander running as a surprise for her husband, Travis.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Mike’s 1939 Hudson Coupe-Convertible is the only survivor of three that were built. He wants Fantomworks to restore it to original condition – even though nobody knows what that looks like. Jim wants his 1970 Nova to be the ultimate dragster.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas install airbags on the 48 Dodge. Team gets ready for the Galveston Classic Car show.

programme.title: The Ride Life
programme.desc: Sung's dive into the world's car cultures takes him to Poland, a country that emerged from a repressive communist era. Sung finds that new freedoms have led to an explosion of optimist and energy, and one of the most exciting experiences of his life.

programme.desc: Joes mor avlegger et overraskelsesbesøk, noe som bekymrer Allison fordi hun ikke har sett henne siden hennes synske evner ble offentlig kjent.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison prøver å finne sammenhengen mellom Ariels spådom om døden til en klassekamerats mor og drømmene hennes relatert til Cynthia og Devalos' drapssak.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Mens Allison jobber for å finne en savnet lokal jente, får hun vite hemmeligheter fra Cynthia Keeners fortid.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: En sjokkerende og brutal konklusjon venter Allison og Cynthia når de fordyper seg i den tiår gamle saken om kidnappingen og drapet på Cynthias datter.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Mens Allison slår seg sammen med Scanlon for å spore opp den farlige "cougaren" de mener er ansvarlig for drapene på unge menn, har hun også syner om at Devalos' kampanje er i fare.

programme.title: Medium

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Scanlon etterforsker drapet på en rik lokal narkolanger. Allison og Scanlon blir lamslått når Allisons drømmer fører dem til en alvorlig funksjonshemmet mann.

programme.title: Medium

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Karen blir sendt på sykehuset i all hast når fødselen starter. Etter at Sean truer Leslie, forteller hun Dex hvem Sean egentlig er.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis advarer Blake om Seans sanne identitet. Blake blir bekymret for familiens sikkerhet og drar til Natumbre sammen med Dex for å avdekke Seans mystiske plan vedrørende Vitron-avtalen.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Etter eksplosjonen i Natumbre blir Blake anklaget for ulovlig våpenhandel. Alexis finner bevis på at Sean betalte Jesse for å komme tilbake til Denver, for at han skulle overtale Karen til å beholde Adams baby.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Dana prøver desperat å overbevise Adam om hvor inderlig hun vil ha sønnen deres. Hun foreslår at hvis de fremstår som et sammensveiset par igjen, vil dommeren dømme i deres favør.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Adam blir fritatt for mistanke om at han har kidnappet sønnen sin når Leslie forteller ham at Sean har tatt babyen og holder henne fanget.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Etter Seans død, finner Alexis trøst i Dex' vennskap, og de blåser liv i lidenskapen igjen.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Sammy Jo og Jeff blir lettet når de finner ut at liket som oppdages i vannet ikke er Krystle.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake nyter tiden sammen med Krystle i Dayton, og er fortsatt forvirret over hukommelsessvikten hennes, og frykter at det skal skje igjen.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake gir Jeff en tredel av kontrollen i Denver-Carrington, og utsetter Adams planer om å ta full kontroll over selskapet.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis mistenker at regnskapsføreren har samarbeidet med Sean for å ruinere Colbyco, og innser at hun kan miste imperiet sitt. Sammy Jo finner ut at Jeff kysset Fallon.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystle er omgitt av de hun elsker og bestemmer seg for å leve. Fallon tar bildet av Blake og den døde mannen med på likhuset, uvitende om at hun blir observert.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Dex tolker Alexis' vendetta mot Blake som et kjærlighets-/hatforhold, og forteller Alexis at han har fått nok av å bli tatt for gitt.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystle går med på operasjon, men først etter at Blake signerer skilsmissepapirene og livstestamentet, som skal settes i live hvis operasjonen mislykkes.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystles operasjon mislykkes, og hun havner i koma. Da Blake blir fortalt at hun sannsynligvis ikke vil våkne, vender han hjem til Denver i sorg. Sammy Jo blir overfalt av en ukjent person.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake frykter at hans mørke hemmelighet vil bli avslørt pga. letingen etter Roger Grimes' morder, og bestemmer seg for å ta støyten for å få en slutt på etterforskningen. Dex og Sable er begge ute etter Heath.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Sammy Jo gjenkjenner Gibson som mannen Krystle så i marerittene sine, og Blake sverger på å beskytte familiehemmeligheten med sitt liv. Adam finner ut om Virginias hemmelige fortid.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis hyrer en leiesoldat for å få skipene tilbake. Adam og Jeff slåss når Jeff påstår at Adam er illojal overfor Blake. Dex begynner å tvile på at Alexis noen gang kan tilby ham kjærligheten han trenger.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Sable prøver å overbevise Blake om at hun er på hans side. Dex blir tiltrukket av lojaliteten hennes. Sammy Jo blir stadig mer interessert i Tanner McBride. Dex angriper Adam når han hører at han utnyttet Virginia.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Sable overtaler Heath til å ikke drepe henne. Etter den rystende hendelsen finner hun trøst hos Dex. Alexis drar til Paris for å holde øye med Boyds kommandooperasjon.

programme.desc: Tom and Diana search for someone who is kidnapping young 4400s. Shawn is threatened by the Nova Group.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: With Dennis Ryland's help, NTAC tracks down the remaining members of the Nova Group. Nikki pays Shawn an unexpected visit.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana are drugged with a hallucinogen, which was created from an oil secreted from the hands of a 4400.

programme.title: The 4400

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana's investigation into a series of gruesome murders leads them to uncover another conspiracy within the government. At the 4400 Center, Shawn receives a gift from another returnee that allows him to see his future.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: NTAC and the 4400 Center work together to find Jordan Collier. Kyle Baldwin gets a surprising visitor at the state prison.

programme.title: The 4400

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana continue their investigation on Jordan Collier's plan for mankind. Dennis Ryland returns to NTAC. Isabelle is seriously injured when she takes a classroom hostage.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A high school student develops an ability after injecting promicin. Tom visits Isabelle in jail, while Diana searches for her missing sister. Following the advice of a young woman named Cassie, Kyle is able to wake Shawn from his coma.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana search for a person who has the ability to make people's worst fears come to life. Danny seeks Shawn's help in finding a promicin shot. Cassie leads Kyle to a book that contains a prophecy about Jordan Collier.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Audrey Parker develops the ability to astral project herself. However, after she is murdered, Audrey attempts to use her ability to lead Tom and Diana to her killer.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: April's new ability endangers her life. Shawn is approached to run for public office, while Kyle helps Isabelle.

programme.desc: After realizing Tom knows he is promicin-positive, Kyle joins Jordan in a remote town called Evanston. Tom follows Kyle, and learns the remarkable truth about Evanston: all of its residents are promicin-positive.

programme.desc: Following the trail of the mass grave, Freddie & Kate uncover an epic secret & find themselves trapped in the cellar of Oculto, one of the more reclusive & dangerous Lords of the Night.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: Hidden in County Wicklow's woods, this eerie Irish sculpture park features massive black granite statues exploring birth, death, and the darker sides of the human mind. Designed for adult reflection, every figure tells a deeply thought-provoking story.

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring one of the world’s most amazing abandoned theme parks in China, built to rival Disney but abandoned after going bankrupt just a few years later.

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: In Japan's Fukushima radiation zone, urban explorers document abandoned JDM cars left since the 2011 nuclear disaster. Geiger counter in hand, they discover rare models including an R32 GTR and an Evo VII frozen in time.

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned 5-star casino hotel in Macau, once closed by the government over safety issues and rumored crime, now left as a haunting time capsule.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Cranebank near Heathrow trained thousands of British Airways staff from the 1960s until 2021, now abandoned as a haunting aviation relic.
programme.sub-title: The Abandoned London Airport Terminal: 747 Planes Parked Forever (Shocking Discovery)

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: A cancelled China road trip leads to exploring an abandoned luxury villa park with pools, saunas, a cinema, and lavish interiors slowly reclaimed by nature.

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: Inside an abandoned Fukushima house and store, explorers uncover rare Japanese gaming memorabilia and toys untouched since the 2011 nuclear disaster. Rising radiation levels and structural hazards add danger to every step.

programme.title: Steve Ronin
programme.desc: Steve explores Taiwan’s abandoned UFO Village, a bizarre ghost town filled with futuristic homes that look straight out of another world.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Silver City Galleria was a large Taunton, MA mall with 120 stores and many amenities. It served the region and was demolished in 2021.

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: Deep in Fukushima's red zone, explorers discover an untouched high-end tuxedo shop and jewelry store, finding hundreds of abandoned suits worth £500, £1000 each, watches, and gems left behind since the 2011 disaster.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: A billionaire heir inherited a 15,000 sq ft mansion and luxury cars. After losing his wife, he hoarded until his death, leaving it frozen in time.
programme.sub-title: Almost Robbed In Abandoned Mansion (Millions of Dollars and Cars Left Behind)

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: Explorers visit a uniquely surreal abandoned house whose entire front façade has collapsed, exposing the interior like a doll's house. The adventure takes an unexpected turn when local farmers arrive and start firing a shotgun in the garden.

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned top secret Titan I missile silo in Colorado, one of six built during the Cold War when nuclear missiles stood ready for launch.
programme.sub-title: Secret Titan I Missile Silo of the United States

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: In Scotland, Dan venture through a vast, decaying Victorian psychiatric hospital. Untouched patient rooms and medical equipment lie abandoned. The team uncovers dark histories of overcrowding and mistreatment, while hunting for paranormal activity.

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned car factory in Sicily where Fiat Panda, Punto, 500 and Lancia Ypsilon were built, closed in 2011 and now planned for reindustrialization.
programme.sub-title: Exploring a Complete Intact Abandoned Car Factory

programme.title: Steve Ronin
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned property once sold to become a horse preserve, left undeveloped for years, with stories of its former owners adding mystery.
programme.sub-title: This Abandoned Mansion Still Had Jewelry Locked Inside

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: Dan enters a long-abandoned hospital deep in Japan's Fukushima Red Zone. Overgrown paths and radiation fears set an uneasy tone as the team investigates the eerie site, encountering unexplained noises along the way.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Formosa Fun Coast in Taiwan closed after a 2015 color powder fire killed 15 and injured 508. The park has been abandoned ever since.
programme.sub-title: The Accident That Shocked the World - Abandoned Water Park Disaster

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned luxury hotel near Dubai, once built as a palace for Abu Dhabi rulers, closed since 2016 and now frozen in time.
programme.sub-title: Discovered an Abandoned Luxury Hotel in Dubai

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Greeks Play Land, built in 1970 by The Greek for handicapped children using repurposed materials, was free to all but closed after his death due to lack of upkeep.

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring abandoned military sites in France and Kuwait, from a NATO airbase with Soviet gear to Saddam Husseins vehicle graveyard on Failaka Island.
programme.sub-title: Abandoned Armies: Soviet Tanks & Saddam’s Rusting War Machines

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring Colorado’s abandoned mining sites and the forbidden ghost town of Gilman, closed in 1984 by the EPA due to toxic pollution.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: An episode exploring abandoned Fukushima shops left intact and a highly contaminated car graveyard, showing rarely seen, previously undocumented sites.
programme.sub-title: The Radiation Ghost Mall inside Japan's Abandoned City (Highly Contaminated)

programme.title: Kill, Baby Kill!
programme.desc: En fjellby hjemsøkes av et gjenferd i form av en liten morderisk jente, noe som får en rettsmedisiner og en medisinstudent til å forsøke å avsløre hennes hemmeligheter, mens en heks bruker sine kunster for å beskytte landsbyboerne.

programme.title: Summer of Fear
programme.desc: En tenårings liv rakner når hennes mystiske kusine flytter inn etter en tragedie. Merkelige hendelser eskalerer, og hun aner mørke krefter. Når ingen tror henne, må hun avsløre sannheten før ondskapen tar over.

programme.title: The Raven
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Dark Star NO
programme.desc: Det er midten av 2000-tallet, og mennesket har utforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forlatt jorden for å finne nye hjem i universet. Det væpnede romskipet "Dark Star" skal bane vei for alle de fredelige kolonistene.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En overraskelseseliminering vender opp ned på ting i husene. Parene dykker dypere inn i opplevelsen. Noen partnere opplever at de beveger seg lenger unna hverandre.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En ny twist får ting til å skje i begge villaene. Great og Nafeesah tar forholdet sitt til neste nivå. Hall kommer til en livsendrende konklusjon. Marisela gjenoppdager seg selv da skyldfølelsen begynner å sette inn for Paris.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Fristelseslyset er en konstant påminnelse om at det ikke er noen hemmeligheter på øya og alle handlinger har konsekvenser.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Det er på tide med videomeldinger og Mark avslører en annen sjokkerende vri. De single får også lov til å sende videomeldinger. Hvem mottar en melding?

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene håndterer ettervirkningene av videomeldinger i begge villaene. Nye relasjoner blir sterkere og mer intime. Andre begynner å slite med skyldfølelse og usikkerhet da slutten av oppholdet nærmer seg.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene drar på romantiske overnattingsdater med de beste single. Ny romantikk blomstrer, kjærlighetserklæringer og fremtidsplaner lages, og mer enn én person lar seg friste.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene Marisela & Christopher og Vanessa & Roberto gjenforenes for deres eksplosive siste bål. Var forholdet deres sterkt nok til å seire på Temptation Island?

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Kaitlin & Hall og Paris & Great gjenforenes til sine siste bålseremonier. Bål har en egen evne til å avdekke sannheten – selv om denne sannheten har vært en løgn.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene og de single vender tilbake til en dramatisk gjenforening på 90 minutter etter tiden på øya.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En time med tidligere usett materiale, inkludert dramatiske øyeblikk fra bålseremoniene, avsløringer fra deltakerne og mye mer.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: ire nye par tar en reise til Temptation Island for å se om forholdet deres tåler alt.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Singlene flytter inn, og det går vilt for seg. Det første «bålet» byr på smertefulle oppvåkninger.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Noen par begynner å nyte sin nyvunnede uavhengighet, mens andre forblir fast i fortiden.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Spenningen øker i villaene, og linjene blir uklare på Anything But Clothes-festen.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Mark kommer med en uventet vending under elimineringen, noe som ryster deltakerne i begge villaene.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Følelsene er store etter det mest dramatiske bålet til nå. Overraskelsesgjester kommer for ryste stemningen.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene sender videomeldinger til partnerne sine etter hvert som båndene til de single blir sterkere.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Etter videomeldingene – eller mangelen på disse – står parene overfor ny tvil og usikkerhet.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene drar på sine siste dater med overnatting. Gammel kjærlighet settes på prøve av nye muligheter.
